name: Save Artifact
description: Save a file to this agent's durable artifacts directory for later retrieval and UI browse/download.

function.name: save_artifact
function.description: Save lasting outputs (HTML pages, reports, CSVs, images, PDFs, exports) into this chat session's artifacts store so they appear in the Files panel and can be previewed/downloaded. ALWAYS call this in the same turn after you create a user-facing deliverable — writing a workplace file alone does not register an artifact. Prefer source_path for a file you just wrote; use content for UTF-8 text. Served at /api/sessions/<session-id>/artifacts/<filename>.

filename.description: Basename only (e.g. report.md, chart.png). No path separators.

content.description: UTF-8 text to write. Ignored if source_path is set.

source_path.description: Existing file path under the workplace, or workplace_id:path, or /_portal/name/....
